purpose: Define explicit person/organization membership and role relations without conflating membership with IdentityCore parenthood, Project participation or AccessCore group membership.

topics.name: Organization Membership
topics.purpose: Define explicit person/organization membership and role relations without conflating membership with IdentityCore parenthood, Project participation or AccessCore group membership.

semantics.membership_rule: Membership is an explicit canonical relation between exact person and organization identities.
semantics.role_rule: Organization role/title may be explicit relation metadata.
semantics.time_rule: Membership validity interval is explicit where machine-significant.
semantics.parent_rule: Membership does not imply IdentityCore parent relation unless separately declared.
semantics.project_rule: Organization membership does not imply participation in any Project.
semantics.access_rule: Organization membership does not automatically create AccessCore group membership/rights.
semantics.history_rule: Ended membership remains historical evidence where retained by policy.

invariants.rule: IdentityCore owns stable person/organization identity and explicit identity relations; credentials, profiles, merits and authorization remain separate semantic layers.

hard_gates.condition: organization membership grants AccessCore rights automatically
role exists only as display text where machine-significant

references.purpose: Project participation remains separate from organization membership.
